integrity: The universal exclusion is symbolic; exact computation is used only to replay rational arithmetic and the five explicit divisor partitions. Targeted literature searches cannot exclude unindexed prior work.
scientific_limitations: Only the minimum multiplicity layer for \(3\)-layered numbers is classified; no assertion is made for \(\Omega(n)\ge6\), and \(I(n)\ge3\) is not claimed sufficient in general.
title: The boundary multiplicity layer of \(3\)-layered numbers
